q: What is the carbon footprint of a law firm per lawyer?
title: Law firm carbon footprint per lawyer
short: Office electricity, mostly air conditioning and IT, is the firm's main Scope 2. Business travel, commuting, paper, IT equipment and cloud services are Scope 3 and often larger. Divide the total by lawyers or by all staff, and name the denominator so the figure compares year to year.
audience: Law firms, CA firms and other professional practices

ul: Scope 1: DG diesel, refrigerant top ups.
Scope 2: office electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh.
Scope 3: flights, hotel stays, commuting, paper, laptops, cloud and courier.

p: Clients collecting supplier data usually want your Scope 1 and 2 and the share billed to them.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
